c0: Every enterprise gets assets back. Each one is a decision worth money. Circularity is the agentic decision layer that makes it, and it plugs into the systems you already run.
c1: Leaders start with a briefing, not a dashboard. Two point four million dollars recovered, one point seven million in new purchases avoided, and the value at risk right now, with its owner.
c2a: And it is plug and play. No rip and replace. Circularity connects to what you already run: lease, E R P, asset management, repair, warehouse, quality and market data. Those systems stay the system of record.
c2b: Agents keep those connections healthy. Here, one explains why the market feed is stale, and what fixes it.
c2c: In Workflow Studio, describe an integration in plain words. The agent drafts the pipeline step by step and checks it. A person decides whether to accept it.
c3a: Step one, evidence. Asset and Product Intelligence brings everything your systems know about one returned motor into a single view: identity, lease, return and transit, condition, certification, and the cost inputs.
c3b: Everything on this page is retrieved, never guessed, and every value traces back to the record it came from.
c4a: The agents turn that evidence into a decision. Every input is frozen in an evidence snapshot: the source system, the exact record, the time it was fetched, and a checksum.
c4b: Steps two and three. Seven possible next lives are built and priced. Six pass the eligibility gates. One is withheld, with the reason.
c4c: Redeploying it against the customer's replacement order wins. Ninety-six hundred dollars, forty-eight hundred ahead of selling, with a range and high confidence. And it explains exactly why.
c4d: Step four, stress it. If the confirmed demand is cancelled, the ranking changes in front of you. Nothing is hidden.
c5a: Step five. The planner submits. Agents prepare. People commit.
c5b: The approver sees the drafted rationale, their own approval limit, and the exact instruction, before anything leaves. Your systems stay authoritative for the work.
c6a: Behind the screen, every stage was run by Circularity's agents. The agent, the tool it called, the system it reached, and the audit record that proves it.
c6b: Where models decide, they are named, with their measured error. Gradient-boosted pricing, and a vision model that checks the inspection photos.
c6c: Steps six to nine. The approved plan goes into your order, maintenance and warehouse processes. Each system does the work, and sends its reference back.
c7: Step ten. The outcome comes back. Ninety-six hundred predicted, ninety-two thirty actual, explained cost line by cost line, and every line names the model that learns.
c8: Plug and play. Agent first. Human governed. Your systems run the work. Circularity makes sure it is the right work.
